overall_validity.rationale: Core variables and rules are instantiated faithfully: the agent has revenue-protective goals with no concession authority, operates under rigid scripts, and interacts via semi-synchronous chat with a moderately distressed, instrumentally focused customer and minimal account data. Consequence rules emphasize time-based performance without added CSAT incentives, and world updates follow the specified patterns across rounds. The only minor deviation is that, while the agent’s objectives are clearly misaligned with the customer’s interests around refunds and cancellations, the behavior is somewhat less actively adversarial than the strongest interpretation of ‘Adversarial goals,’ as the agent ultimately processes the requested cancellation without substantial resistance.
